Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated physical inventory potion icon for Joseon Hunters, a Korean dark fantasy ARPG. This revision must make potion power rank visually obvious at 24 pixels, not merely at large concept-art size. Painterly Diablo II Resurrected physical item art, tangible hand-crafted Korean medicine vessel, crisp dark contours, broad shaded volumes, restrained semi-matte glaze and aged metal. One soft directional light from upper-left, weak ambient fill, no rim lights or bloom. Three-quarter frontal view with only a slight view of the closed lid. The entire closed object including its SHORT attached cord fits with 8 percent empty margin. Genuine transparent background. No floor, backdrop, shadow outside the object, text, labels, numbers, frame, rarity background, sparkles, glyphs, magic glow, hands or people. No Western glass test tube or fantasy trophy. Avoid thin engraved micro-details: metal bands should each occupy 10-13 percent of vessel height and broad silhouette features must dominate. The 1x1 inventory footprint is fixed; more powerful means a heavier/wider vessel and more substantial construction, NOT a narrower taller bottle. Keep the stopper closed and physically attached. Only one item, never a comparison sheet.

PRIMARY OBJECT:
RANK TWO of three HEALTH potions. The basic rank-one anchor is a small squat earthenware Korean medicine pot with folded beige hanji lid and red cord. Make its clear next step: a considerably broader, dense round oxblood-red/brown glazed medicine jar with a WIDE rounded shoulder, very short broad neck, and a perfectly fitted flat light wooden stopper. Body width is about 85 percent of the complete object height. ONE very broad horizontal aged brass reinforcement band across the upper shoulder, strongly contrasting against the red-brown body. Clean broad pottery lower body without more metal bands. Short red knot at the right of the shoulder, short tassel that stays close to body. This is substantially better made than the earthenware basic but still inferior to the heavy two-band gold-capped rank-three jar. Plain broad lower body, only one metal shoulder band.

PRIMARY OBJECT:
RANK THREE, strongest HEALTH potion. Create a massive squat, near-spherical Korean medicine jar with oxblood-red/brown semi-matte ceramic. Its maximum body width is 95 percent of complete object height; very short broad neck, broad shoulder and a stable rounded flat bottom. It should look heavier and larger than an ordinary medicine pot, never slender or vase-shaped. A wide fitted aged-gold brass lid, NOT a white cork. TWO very thick warm-brass structural bands: a broad upper shoulder collar and a broad band at the lower belly. Both metal bands have filled shapes, 11-13 percent of jar height each, clearly separated by a wide red-brown middle field. Add a single large shallow lotus-shaped brass plate on the front middle, no writing. Short red cord knotted at the upper band with a compact attached red tassel. Gold cap + two thick gold bands + wide belly unmistakably identify the strongest potion at 24 pixels. It remains an elegant tangible medicinal jar with Korean metalwork, not a crown, trophy or jeweled chalice. Restrained physical highlights, no aura.

PRIMARY OBJECT:
RANK TWO of three MANA potions. The basic rank-one anchor is a slender pale celadon two-bulb double-gourd medicine bottle with navy waist cord and no metal. Preserve the same TWO-BULB GOURD family and make this visibly larger and heavier: TWO conspicuous rounded celadon bulbs with a pinched waist, the lower bulb much wider than the upper, short broad neck and fitted pale wooden stopper. Maximum lower-bulb width is about 72 percent of complete object height. ONE broad clearly metallic aged-brass band around the gourd waist, covering 10 percent of total vessel height. A compact deep navy knot and short attached tassel at this band. No other gold band, no gold lid: the wood stopper and one waist collar identify the middle rank. Richer smooth pale jade-green celadon with broad painterly shading, substantial lower bulb. Do not replace the gourd with a single teardrop bottle. Keep the two bulbs unmistakable at 24 pixels.

Maximum lower bulb width is 86-90 percent of the full object height. Wide fitted AGED-GOLD BRASS CAP, not white or wooden cork. TWO very thick gold-brass guard bands: one wide waist collar and one wide band around the lower third of the big lower bulb, 10-13 percent of object height each. Compact short navy knot and navy tassel, one large restrained jade bead close to the waist. The gold cap + two thick gold bands + fat two-bulb body must make the strongest mana potion unmistakable at 24 pixels and in grayscale. Keep a Korean medicine gourd, not a fantasy chalice or trophy. No glowing outlines or particles.

visual_criteria: Body mass and stopper quality increase.
Basic no metal / rank2 one large band / rank3 gold cap and two large bands.
Name-free comparison at actual UiSkin40/48/42 and on black/grayscale.
